desc: Derive and implement the pair-state recurrence for wrapping a palindrome with equal-labeled outer edges.
Implement Dijkstra over ordered vertex-pair states with letter-grouped incoming/outgoing adjacency.
Handle diagonal and direct-edge initialization, duplicate states, self-loops, and unreachable pairs.
Verify correctness and complexity for \(N \leq 100\), including both sample cases.
Produce the final stdin/stdout Python solution in the required delimiters.
